시편 26:1.content: A Psalm of David. Judge me, O Lord; for I have walked in mine integrity: I have trusted also in the Lord; therefore I shall not slide.

시편 26:2.content: Examine me, O Lord, and prove me; try my reins and my heart.

시편 26:3.content: For thy lovingkindness is before mine eyes: and I have walked in thy truth.

시편 26:4.content: I have not sat with vain persons, neither will I go in with dissemblers.

시편 26:5.content: I have hated the congregation of evil doers; and will not sit with the wicked.

시편 26:6.content: I will wash mine hands in innocency: so will I compass thine altar, O Lord:

시편 26:7.content: That I may publish with the voice of thanksgiving, and tell of all thy wondrous works.

시편 26:8.content: Lord, I have loved the habitation of thy house, and the place where thine honour dwelleth.

시편 26:9.content: Gather not my soul with sinners, nor my life with bloody men:

시편 26:10.content: In whose hands is mischief, and their right hand is full of bribes.

시편 26:11.content: But as for me, I will walk in mine integrity: redeem me, and be merciful unto me.

시편 26:12.content: My foot standeth in an even place: in the congregations will I bless the Lord.
